prologue.text: In the capital, King Oswin sits alone each night before the painting of his late queen. "Soon," he whispers.
Far away, smoke rises over the villages of the Whispering Woods again. You take up your weapon and go.

chapter_1_end.text: At dawn a royal knight rides into the camp: Sir Corwin Vale. "The King asks for you."
"The Demon King Malzareth sends his monsters against us. His castle is sealed by four crystals, each guarded by a Demon Lord. Break them, and end him."
"And bring me the dust of every crystal you break," King Oswin says with a warm smile. "For the royal vault."

chapter_2_end.text: The Crystal of Frost cracks and falls into glittering dust. For a moment, the whole mountain seems to breathe out.
A royal envoy waits in town with a purse of 50 gold. "His Majesty thanks you. The crystal's dust, please. For the royal vault."
All the way to the capital, the little chest hums.
